For each team in each year (`team_id`, `year`), average its nonmissing `manager_half` record-level `w / g` values for that year, count its records for that year, and subtract the unweighted mean of the nonmissing team-year averages.

For each distinct `team_id` in `team_half`, calculate the record-level average, record count, and difference, including teams with no `manager_half` records.

queries:
WITH team_stats AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_w_per_g,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
)
SELECT
    team_id,
    avg_w_per_g,
    record_count,
    avg_w_per_g - (SELECT AVG(avg_w_per_g) FROM team_stats) AS difference_from_mean
FROM team_stats;
WITH team_year AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        year,
        AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_w_per_g,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id, year
)
SELECT
    team_id,
    year,
    avg_w_per_g,
    record_count,
    avg_w_per_g - (SELECT AVG(avg_w_per_g) FROM team_year) AS centered_avg_w_per_g
FROM team_year
SELECT
    th.team_id,
    AVG(mh.g) AS avg_manager_games,
    COUNT(mh.rowid) AS manager_record_count,
    AVG(th.g - mh.g) AS avg_games_difference
FROM team_half AS th
LEFT JOIN manager_half AS mh
    ON mh.team_id = th.team_id
   AND mh.year = th.year
   AND mh.league_id = th.league_id
   AND mh.half = th.half
GROUP BY th.team_id;
